title: Dependency Chain Failure
intended_root_cause: The payment Kubernetes Service was deleted, causing the checkout service's reverse proxy to fail DNS resolution for the payment upstream.
expected_symptoms: Frontend returns 502 Bad Gateway to users
expected_evidence: Frontend logs show successful proxy to checkout but checkout returns 502
Checkout logs show host not found in upstream payment.rca-demo.svc.cluster.local
Kubernetes state shows payment service is missing
